methods.label: Find the Jones boys first
methods.explanation:
Of the \(40\) students from Jones, \(20\) are girls, so Jones has
\[
40-20=20\text{ boys}.
\]
All \(52\) boys are from either Jones or Clay. Removing the Jones boys leaves
\[
52-20=\boxed{32}
\]
boys from Clay, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses two elementary subtractions based on parts and totals.
